# GimbalAutoCalibration (command)

Gimbal AutoCalibration - the gimbal self-test/calibration trigger.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** Real class DataGimbalAutoCalibration.start() (dji.go.v4 decompile, dji/midware/data/model/P3/DataGimbalAutoCalibration.java) sends APP->GIMBAL, NEEDACK.YES, EncryptType.NO, 1-byte payload from getSendData(). Confirmed 2026-10-24 against a real wire capture of this exact command working (real pitch movement + mode change observed, awto-dji#16): `550e046602040074200408008c2f` -> sender=APP, receiver=GIMBAL, ackType= beforeExec (byte8 bits5-6 = 1), cmdSet=0x04, cmdId=0x08, payload=[0x00]. Was app/awto_dji_app/lib/link/gimbal_commands.dart's `autoCalibration()` - not previously in scripts/re/duml_commands.py's REGISTRY at all.
